Agent.description:
A registered control-plane agent (fleet member). Returned by `GET /api/agents`
and `GET /api/agents/{agent_id}`.

current_domain_id.description:
Active domain context. Follows the agent when attached elsewhere;
reset to `home_domain_id` on detach. Joined to `domain_name` in API responses.

home_domain_id.description: Permanent home domain — created automatically on first registration.

id.description: Internal database row id (used only for foreign keys; prefer `public_id` externally).

metadata.description: Free-form JSON string with runtime-supplied metadata (e.g. `runtime`, `node_id`).

public_id.description:
Stable, human-readable wire identifier — `{name}-{8-char-hex-suffix}`.
Used by edgeplaned, CLI, TUI, and dashboard for all external references.

AgentMessage.description: A message sent between two control-plane agents.

AgentSession.description: A session record for a control-plane agent (Claude Code run, etc.).

AiEvent.description: A lifecycle / IO / tool / approval event associated with an AI session.

created_at.description: Event creation timestamp, microsecond precision, no timezone suffix.

id.description: Row id (stored as i32 in DB, cast to i64 for wire compatibility).

payload.description: Polymorphic event payload — shape varies by `event_type`.

turn_id.description: Optional parent turn; `null` for session-level events.

AiPendingAction.description: A pending tool-execution action waiting for human approval or rejection.

approved_by.description: Subject that approved the action (empty string if not yet approved).

args.description: Polymorphic tool arguments — shape varies by tool.

created_at.description: Action creation timestamp, microsecond precision, no timezone suffix.

id.description: Stable string identifier (UUID or custom slug stored in the DB).

reason.description: Human-readable reason the runtime requested this action.

rejected_by.description: Subject that rejected the action (empty string if not yet rejected).

rejection_note.description: Rejection note (empty string if action was not rejected).

updated_at.description: Action last-updated timestamp, microsecond precision, no timezone suffix.

AiSession.description:
A full AI session record, including nested turns, events, and pending actions.

Returned by `POST /api/ai/sessions`, `GET /api/ai/sessions/{id}`,
`POST /api/ai/sessions/{id}/turns`, and the action approve/reject endpoints.

`GET /api/ai/sessions` (list) returns a lightweight variant: `turns`,
`events`, and `pending_actions` are empty arrays, and `capability_snapshot`
and `policy` are `null` (those columns are not fetched in the list query for
performance reasons — the wire shape is identical; only the values differ).

capability_snapshot.description:
Snapshot of the `CapabilitySet` at the time the session was created.
Polymorphic — stays as `Value` (→ `unknown` in TypeScript).
`null` in list responses (not fetched in the list query).

created_at.description: Session creation timestamp, microsecond precision, no timezone suffix.

events.description: All events associated with this session (empty in list responses).

owner_subject.description: OIDC subject of the session owner.

pending_actions.description: Pending tool-execution actions awaiting approval (empty in list responses).

policy.description:
Governance policy document applied to this session.
Polymorphic — stays as `Value` (→ `unknown` in TypeScript).
`null` in list responses (not fetched in the list query).

runtime_kind.description: Runtime kind used for this session (e.g. `"claude_code"`, `"opencode"`).

runtime_session_id.description: External runtime session identifier (set by the runtime after launch).

turns.description: Ordered list of turns in this session (empty in list responses).

updated_at.description: Session last-updated timestamp, microsecond precision, no timezone suffix.

workspace_path.description: Filesystem workspace path used by the runtime, if any.

AiTurn.description: A single conversational turn in an AI session.

content.description: Polymorphic turn content — shape varies by role and runtime kind.

created_at.description: Turn creation timestamp, microsecond precision, no timezone suffix.

id.description:
Row id (stored as i32 in DB, cast to i64 for wire compatibility with
the original `row.get::<i32,_>("id") as i64` conversion).

CapabilitySet.description:
A capability descriptor for a supported AI runtime kind.

Returned as an array by `GET /api/ai/runtime-capabilities`.

icon_slug.description: Icon slug used by the frontend asset resolver.

max_context_tokens.description: Maximum usable context window in tokens.

supports_file_workspace.description: Whether this runtime can operate on a file-system workspace.

supports_session_resume.description: Whether a suspended session can be resumed.

supports_skill_packs.description: Whether edgeplaned skill packs are supported.

supports_streaming.description: Whether this runtime supports SSE event streaming.

supports_tool_interception.description: Whether tool calls can be intercepted for approval gating.

policy.description:
Governance policy document to apply to the session.
Polymorphic — stays as `Value`.

runtime_kind.description: Runtime kind to use for this session (defaults to `"opencode"`).

title.description: Optional human-readable session title (defaults to empty string).

ExplorerDomain.description: A domain detail record (nested inside ExplorerNodeDetail).

ExplorerDomainNode.description: A domain node in the explorer tree (top-level container).

mission_count.description: Number of missions in this domain (after filters).

task_count.description: Total task count across all missions (after filters).

ExplorerMission.description: A mission detail record (nested inside ExplorerNodeDetail).

ExplorerMissionNode.description: A mission (workstream) node inside the explorer tree.

task_count.description: Total visible task count for this mission.

ExplorerNodeDetail.description:
Response from `GET /api/explorer/node/{node_type}/{node_id}`.

Shape varies by `node_type`:
- `"domain"`: `domain` + `missions[]` + `tasks[]` are populated; `mission` and `task` are absent.
- `"mission"`: `domain` (nullable), `mission`, `tasks[]` are populated; `missions` is absent.
- `"task"`: `domain` (nullable), `mission`, `task` are populated; `missions` and `tasks` are absent.

MIRROR: heterogeneous response combined into one struct. Optional fields
are `null` when not applicable to the `node_type`.

oneOf.description: Present for all node types; `null` when the mission/task has no parent domain.

ExplorerTask.description: A task detail record (nested inside ExplorerNodeDetail).

ExplorerTaskSummary.description: A task summary inside an explorer tree node.

domains.description: Domains (each containing their missions and task summaries).

unassigned_missions.description: Missions not assigned to any domain.

GovernancePolicyResponse.description:
Response emitted by `GET /api/governance/policy/active` and related
policy-record endpoints.

The `policy` field is now a concrete typed struct rather than
`serde_json::Value`, which allows utoipa to emit a real JSON Schema for the
`policy` object and openapi-typescript to generate a typed TypeScript
interface instead of `unknown`.

Timestamp fields use `NaiveDateTime` which matches the existing wire format
(chrono serializes without a timezone suffix, preserving byte-identical
output vs. the previous `serde_json::json!` construction).

created_by.description: Subject that created this policy record.

published_by.description: Subject that published this policy (empty string for drafts).

status.description: Always `"ok"` when the server is reachable.

McpServerConfig.description: MCP server config block embedded in the onboarding manifest.

env.description: Environment variables required to launch the MCP server.

email.description:
Email address captured at OIDC login — present for browser PKCE sessions, absent
for CLI/device/service-account flows. Intended for avatar initials in the web UI.

session_id.description: Session database ID — present for session tokens, absent for service account tokens.

subject.description: The authenticated principal's subject identifier (e.g. OIDC sub or service account name).

NodeMeshAgent.description:
A mesh agent assigned to a runtime node. Returned by
`GET /api/runtime/nodes/{node_id}/agents`.

MIRROR: handler (`routes/runtime.rs::list_node_agents`) builds JSON via
`routes::work::row_to_agent` + domain join. Fields with open schemas
(`profile`, `machine`, `runtime`, `labels`, `capabilities`) stay as
`serde_json::Value` — their shape is runtime-class dependent.

agent_public_id.description: The linked persistent agent identity, if set at enrollment.

domain_kind.description: Kind of the assigned domain (joined server-side).

domain_name.description: Human name of the assigned domain (joined server-side).

machine.description: Machine descriptor blob (shape varies by runtime_kind).

profile.description: Runtime-class profile blob (shape varies by runtime_kind).

public_id.description: Stable wire identifier (agent public_id or meshagent id as fallback).

runtime.description: Runtime config blob (shape varies by runtime_kind).

OnboardingBootstrap.description: Bootstrap instructions embedded in the onboarding manifest.

OnboardingEndpoints.description: Endpoint URLs embedded in the onboarding manifest.

OnboardingManifest.description:
The onboarding manifest returned by `GET /api/agent-onboarding.json`.

Describes how to connect an agent runtime (edgeplaned) to this EdgePlane
instance. No auth required — the manifest itself contains no secrets.

PolicyActionRule.description:
Per-action rule — controls whether an action is enabled and whether it
requires an approval gate before execution.

enabled.description: Whether the action is allowed at all.

requires_approval.description: Whether the action requires an approval workflow before proceeding.

PolicyDoc.description:
Parsed governance policy document stored in the `policy_json` column.

All top-level sections are optional so that partial documents (e.g. the
seeded default before all subsystems existed) still round-trip cleanly.

oneOf.description: Global flags that apply across all entity actions.

PolicyEvent.description: A single governance policy audit-log event.

actor_subject.description: Subject (user or service) that triggered the event.

detail.description: Arbitrary JSON detail payload (shape varies by event type).

policy_id.description: ID of the policy record this event refers to; `null` for system events.

version.description: Policy version at the time of the event.

PolicyGlobal.description:
Global policy flags that apply across all actions.

All fields use `#[serde(default)]` so older policy documents that lack a
field deserialize without error (field defaults to `false`).

message.description: The user message to add as a new turn.

RuntimeNode.description:
A registered runtime node. Returned by `GET /api/runtime/nodes`.

MIRROR: handler (`routes/runtime.rs::list_nodes`) still builds JSON via
`row_to_node`. Field set matches `row_to_node` exactly; JSON-embedded
fields (`labels`, `capacity`, `capabilities`) stay as `serde_json::Value`
because their schema is caller-defined.

capabilities.description: List of capability strings the node advertises (JSON array of strings).

capacity.description: Capacity declarations — CPU, memory, etc. (JSON object).
